interaction_target: the person or community deciding what behaviour they run
borrowed: nothing. The material is the pack graph itself, and the grammar is a three-column desk: the graph, the closure it resolves to, and what that closure needs of the world.
shape: pick an actor, watch the smallest sufficient closure resolve, and see what changes
refusal_states: refused (401/403) — offers the session that would fill it
empty (200, no packs) — this actor activates nothing
failed (other) — nothing rendered rather than stale or invented
pack_graph_unauthored (503) — the types exist and nobody has authored a pack
actions: none. This surface composes and never commits; changing what an actor runs is an authoring act against pack_installation and pack_activation.
forbidden_inference: an activated pack -> an authorized effect; Authority decides at effect time and is not this organ
a pack -> an identity; a pack is behaviour and holds no authority and no state
a resolved closure -> a permission to read what it composes
a hidden view -> a pattern that stopped answering; hiding is presentation and a machine asking for it gets the same bytes
an overlay -> the ability to widen anything; the verbs are hide, add, specialize, present, tighten and default, and there is no verb for the rest
requires_authority: none to read the graph; a closure names what an actor runs and never what they may do

lineage.note: authored against the canonical integrated architecture: five layers that must never merge, a closed overlay verb list, and the retention ladder
